cues.text: This is Cuneo, where I grew up and went to school.
The town sits on a wedge-shaped plateau between the Stura and the Gesso.
Behind it rises the Bisalta.
And here, my old high school.
The path comes back here, and each time it builds up a little more.
Then Turin, for a Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering at the Polytechnic of Turin.
Its landmark is the Mole Antonelliana.
Beside it, Galileo Ferraris' coils, for his rotating magnetic field.
Together, an illustration for a degree in electrical engineering.
Next, Switzerland, for an MSc in Life Sciences Engineering at EPFL.
It specialized in neuroscience and neuroengineering.
My thesis turned biomedical papers into a detailed analysis or a TL;DR.
At Roche, in Basel, I took a filling prototype through integration testing.
And built a model that tunes fill parameters 20% faster than manual tuning.
At Burgeon Labs, in Geneva, I fine-tuned language models to summarize biomedical literature.
Back in Cuneo, I taught math and physics at my old high school.
As a freelancer, I built an interior-design MVP with Stable Diffusion.
I fine-tuned it with Dreambooth on a hand-curated dataset of room designs.
I preprocessed the dataset myself.
Then I killed it on the evidence, after customer discovery.
Then France, as an AI Engineer at GSK, in Saint-Amand-les-Eaux, near Lille.
I found inefficiencies across pharmaceutical utilities.
And designed water rejection strategies projected to save 10,000 m³ a year.
I built anomaly detection and time-series forecasting for manufacturing.
And semantic NLP for fault detection and maintenance decisions.
And natural-language interfaces that made plant data usable on the floor.
Home again, as founding AI engineer at a stealth GenAI startup.
I built a RAG stack with custom parsing for handwritten content.
And tuned it with tracing and evaluation workflows.
And led MVP engineering, managing two other developers.
Now I'm an AI Product Engineer at Complaion.
It helps European SMEs get real value from ISO certifications.
I'm building the agentic AI core of the product.
Backed by evaluations that track reliability in production.
And the last step is a question mark.
A blank card with empty clue slots.
After La Ghigliottina, the quiz round that finds the word connecting five clues.
It's not yet written.
The flat site has my email, and germinai, the newsletter, for what comes next.
